The '''septoid''', or '''Ja field septoid''', was a seven-legged [[Insect/Legends|insect]] indigenous to the [[Ja highlands]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. Septoids were fearless pests that survived centuries of attempts to exterminate them, only to adapt and thrive once more. Their exposure to the Eriaduan global pollution only seemed to make them hardier and more numerous, hence the Eriaduan expression 'tough as a septoid.' Its central thorax contained its head and [[Eye/Legends|eyestalks]], as well as two sets of venom-less fangs. Its seven legs radiated outward in such a way that the septoid had no true front or back. These legs were made of serrated chitin, and made a distinctive sound when the septoid walked on hard surfaces, such as [[duracrete]].<ref name="GatORW" />

The [[WED-15 Septoid Treadwell/Legends|WED-15]] droid series was named and somewhat patterned after the septoid.<ref name="ANHL">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=WED15-I7 "Septoid" Droid}}</ref>
